description: A10 Wave 8 — 200 Vietlish/interference review candidates. Fresh territory: verb+preposition collocations (depend on, interested in, listen to, etc.), countable/uncountable mass nouns (information, advice, furniture), article errors (play the piano, a kind person), reported speech (said me→told me), passive form errors (write→written, build→built), emotional verb prepositions (worried for→about), conditional errors (if I will have→if I have), sports/recreation calques (play sport, practices badminton), weather calques (there have wind, today is hot weather), adverb/adjective confusion (good→well, talent→talented, success→successful), subject-verb agreement (3rd person -s), gerund/infinitive alternation (enjoy cooking, avoid making, keep talking), too-to/enough-to constructions, causative get (get fixed), make/do collocates, register calques (VN formal politeness in English), literal translation idioms (eat to your fullness, thin wallet, sweet tongue). Deduped vs live(353) + waves 1-7(1393) = 1744-item denylist. Zero collisions.

entries.vietlish: she wins a medal of gold at the contest
entries.natural: she wins a gold medal at the contest
entries.sourcePattern: huy chương vàng (medal of gold → gold medal, adjective-noun order)

entries.vietlish: she has a very strong patient personality
entries.natural: she has a very patient personality
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy có tính cách kiên nhẫn (patient noun used as adjective, meaning already in 'personality')
bộ phim hài hước (amuse verb → amusing adjective)

entries.vietlish: I find this topic very fascinate
entries.natural: I find this topic very fascinating
entries.sourcePattern: chủ đề hấp dẫn (fascinate verb → fascinating adjective)
entries.context: expressing enthusiasm for an interesting subject

entries.vietlish: the ending of the story was very satisfy
entries.natural: the ending of the story was very satisfying
entries.sourcePattern: kết thúc câu chuyện thỏa mãn (satisfy verb → satisfying adjective)
entries.context: reviewing a book or film with a good ending

entries.vietlish: the children are very amuse by the clown
entries.natural: the children are very amused by the clown
entries.sourcePattern: bọn trẻ cảm thấy vui (amuse → amused, past participle)

entries.vietlish: the two informations are contradicting each other
entries.natural: the two pieces of information contradict each other
entries.sourcePattern: hai thông tin mâu thuẫn (informations → pieces of information; contradicting → contradict)
entries.context: pointing out conflicting details in a report

entries.vietlish: I invite you to please come to my house
entries.natural: I'd love to have you over
entries.sourcePattern: tôi kính mời bạn đến nhà (mời = invite, formal VN register unnecessary in casual English)
entries.context: inviting a friend or classmate to your home informally

entries.vietlish: I report to you that the meeting is done
entries.natural: just wanted to let you know the meeting is done
entries.sourcePattern: tôi xin báo cáo (báo cáo = formal report-up, over-formal for casual workplace update)
entries.context: giving a colleague a quick informal update after a meeting

entries.vietlish: I beg your pardon for this serious trouble
entries.natural: I'm really sorry for the inconvenience
entries.sourcePattern: kính xin tha lỗi vì sự cố (beg your pardon + serious trouble = stacked over-apology, VN formality)
entries.context: apologising for a mistake or delay in a customer interaction

entries.vietlish: with deep respect I would like to express my opinion
entries.natural: I'd like to share my thoughts
entries.sourcePattern: với sự tôn trọng sâu sắc (deep respect opener = VN kính thưa stacked formality, odd in English opinion-sharing)
entries.context: opening a class discussion or meeting contribution

entries.vietlish: let the rice sit for a while
entries.sourcePattern: để cơm nghỉ một lát (sit vs rest — VN cooking calque for resting rice after cooking)
entries.context: giving a cooking instruction for steamed rice

entries.vietlish: she knows how to speak many mouths
entries.sourcePattern: biết nói nhiều thứ tiếng / nhiều ngôn ngữ (many mouths = VN informal nhiều miệng/tiếng joke-calque)

entries.vietlish: he is a long hand person
entries.natural: he has a habit of stealing things
entries.sourcePattern: tay dài (long hand = tay dài, VN idiom for someone who steals)
